schemes.name: Carer's Credit
schemes.gives: National Insurance credits that protect your State Pension while you care.
schemes.how: Apply by post or phone to the Carer's Allowance Unit. If you get Carer's Allowance you get the credits already.

schemes.name: Help to Save
schemes.gives: A 50p bonus for every £1 saved, up to £1,200 over 4 years.
schemes.how: Open an account online with HMRC. You can save between £1 and £50 a month.

schemes.name: Access to Work
schemes.gives: A grant for support at work, like equipment, a support worker or taxis to work. It doesn't affect other benefits.
schemes.how: Check and apply online. It also helps with mental health support at work and communication support at interviews.
schemes.worthChecking: Depends on the support your job needs
